name: Asaumi Tatsuya
source:
Department: General Affairs
First Impressions: Easily Talked Too, Kind

He's responsible for training the protagonist in her new job at the company.
He's a kind older brother type that looks friendly at first glance but he seems to shy away from deeper connections like he's drawing a line somewhere. It seems there's a secret involved.
He actually graduated at the top of his class from a famous university and is very sharp.
The president realized that ability and offered to promote him away from general affairs, but he doesn't like to stand out so he refused.
